entities.summary: Hedda Maria Emerence Adelaïde Elisabeth Ekman, née Åkerhielm, credited as Elisabeth Ekman, was a Swedish botanist, noted for her study of the genus Draba. She became a prominent researcher despite having no real academic background education or degree.
